PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?brother ?instrument ?place_grew_up
WHERE
  { ?composer  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/music.composer.compositions>  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.0jxk_hq>
    OPTIONAL
      { ?composer  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.person.sibling_s>  ?sibling_relation .

                  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.sibling_relationship.sibling>  ?brother

    OPTIONAL
      { ?composer  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/music.artist.track_contributions>  ?contribution .
        ?contribution
                  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/music.track_contribution.role>  ?instrument

    OPTIONAL
      { ?composer  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.person.places_lived>  ?place_lived .

  }

PREFIX ns: <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?person
WHERE {
  {
    # Who are the people in the Ohio state government with Barry Goldwater?
    ?govbody ns:government.governmental_body.members ?pos1 .
    ?pos1 ns:government.government_position_held.office_holder ns:m.01j6t .
    ?govbody ns:government.governmental_body.members ?pos2 .
    ?pos2 ns:government.government_position_held.office_holder ?person .
    ?pos2 ns:government.government_position_held.district_represented ns:m.05kkh .
    FILTER(?person != ns:m.01j6t)
  }
  UNION
  {
    # Who served in the Republican political party and is the current Ohio State senator?
    ?govbody ns:government.governmental_body.members ?pos .
    ?pos ns:government.government_position_held.office_holder ?person .
    ?pos ns:government.government_position_held.district_represented ns:m.05kkh .
    FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?pos ns:government.government_position_held.from ?from} || 
      EXISTS {?pos ns:government.government_position_held.from ?from . 
      FILTER(xsd:dateTime(?from) <= "2015-08-10T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime)})
    FILTER(NOT EXISTS {?pos ns:government.government_position_held.to ?to} || 
      EXISTS {?pos ns:government.government_position_held.to ?to . 
      FILTER(xsd:dateTime(?to) >= "2015-08-10T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime)})
    ?person ns:government.politician.party ?partytenure .
    ?partytenure ns:government.political_party_tenure.party ns:m.07wbk .
  }
  UNION
  {
    # Which Ohio state governmental body office is held by William R King?
    ?govbody ns:government.governmental_body.members ?wingpos .
    ?wingpos ns:government.government_position_held.office_holder ns:m.0m8fn .
    ?govbody ns:government.governmental_body.members ?pos .
    ?pos ns:government.government

question: Where was the person who spoke about the Berlin Wall raised?
sparql:
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?speaker ?numSiblings ?religionName
WHERE
  { ?speaker  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/event.public_speaker.speeches_or_presentations>  ?speech .
    ?speech   <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/event.speech_or_presentation.speech_topic>  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.017f5>
    OPTIONAL
      { ?speaker  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.deceased_person.date_of_death>  ?dateOfDeath }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?speaker  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.person.sibling>  ?sibling }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?speaker  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/base.popstra.celebrity.religion>  ?religionEntity .
        ?religionEntity
                  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/base.popstra.religion_choice.religion>  ?religionName
      }
    { PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
      PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
      PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
      PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
      PREFIX  dc:   <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
      
      SELECT  ?speaker (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sibling) AS ?numSiblings)
      WHERE
        { ?speaker  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/event.public_speaker.speeches_or_presentations>  ?speech2 .
          ?speech2  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/event.speech_or_presentation.speech_topic>  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.017f5>
          OPTIONAL
            { ?speaker  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/people.person.sibling>  ?sibling }
        }
      GROUP BY ?speaker
    }
  }
ORDER BY ?dateOfDeath
LIMIT   1

question: To which political party does the public speaker advocating for Educational reform belong?

SELECT DISTINCT  ?result

    ?speech  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/event.speech_or_presentation.speech_topic>  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/m.02mdg>
      { ?c    <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/government.politician.government_positions_held>  ?pos .
        ?pos  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/government.government_position_held.office_position_or_title>  ?result
        FILTER ( ?result != ?c )
        OPTIONAL
          { ?pos  <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/government.government_position_held.to>  ?end }

        FILTER ( ?result != ?c )

  }

  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?name), "bluegrass") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?capitalCity), "lexington") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?capitalCity), "frankfort")) .

}
LIMIT 1

  }
